searchText: Even if we build custom storage layer for Eth, wouldn't it be hard to provide gaurantees about the data availability, eg: what if a node dies and it has some critical piece of information and it never comes back. one way is to have data replication/ but it's still not clear if the nodes where this data is replicated are not gaunranteed to be malicious cc: <@!840137734768689163> Hey everyone, I'm not sure where to post this but since this is about apprenticeships I thought here would be fine. I'm a student from Belgium looking for an unpaid internship in another country (US would be awesome), and since crypto and eth stuff is basically all I do right now, I would love to find something related. Is there a place I can go to to find such internship postings? i don't know of any central spot for listing internships, sorry this channel is for the self-directed apprenticeship program and this repo provides an overview of what this self-directed program entails <@!329980634552598528> : https://github.com/ethereum-cdap/cohort-one Much appreciated!
